items.title: Falcons' Pearce suspended 8 games after arrest
items.description: Falcons edge rusher James Pearce Jr. will be suspended by the NFL for eight games due to violating the league's personal conduct policy, the league announced Friday afternoon.

items.title: Tua Tagovailoa: Inside track to Week 1 start, per Fowler
items.description:
Tagovailoa has the "inside track" to be named the Falcons' starting quarterback ahead of Week 1, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Commanders' Armstrong suspended for opener
items.description: Commanders defensive end/linebacker Dorance Armstrong has been suspended without pay for the season opener for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy.

items.description:

items.title: Bills D-lineman Mathis suspended 3 games by NFL
items.description: Bills defensive tackle Phidarian Mathis has been suspended for the first three games of the season for violating the NFL's substance abuse policy.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Not playing Saturday

items.title: Saints WR Tyson to miss time due to hamstring
items.description: Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson has a right hamstring issue and will miss time, according to Saints coach Kellen Moore.

items.title: Seahawks cite 'positive' reviews in adding Arnold
items.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said one factor in the team's decision to offer Terrion Arnold a contract despite the felony charges he's facing was the "overwhelmingly positive" reviews they heard while vetting the free agent cornerback.

items.title: Aikman gets Brady-like limits for MNF broadcasts
items.description: ESPN analyst Troy Aikman will see some restrictions in the lead-up to "Monday Night Football" broadcasts similar to those for Fox's Tom Brady.
